# 11 Wire namespaces, notes, annotations and generics end to end

## Outcome

`render()` handles a `classDiagram` using every structural feature — annotations, generics,
namespaces, notes and `direction` — verified end to end rather than only at each stage's seam,
and the demo grows a second example covering them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `render()` on a source with a namespace, a free note, an attached note, an annotated class
  and a generic class mounts a correctly structured SVG with the expected group counts and ids.
- [ ] `direction LR` versus the same document with no `direction` produces different class
  positions through the real pipeline.
- [ ] `render()` on a source whose `note for` targets an unknown class returns the model's error
  diagnostic and does not throw.
- [ ] `demos/class-diagram.html` shows a second example exercising these features.

## Test seam

`render(source, container, options?): SirenRenderResult` — integration under jsdom, extending
ticket 06's test file.
